fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION...Today and tonight... Slightly cooler temperatures are expected today, with slight increase in moisture. Scattered afternoon showers and thunderstorms will develop across the Front Range mountains this afternoon and spill onto the the plains. Lightning and gusty erratic winds are possible with any high-based storm that develops. LONG TERM DISCUSSION...Wednesday through Saturday... No

alerts.title: US 40 over Shelton Ditch-143206
alerts.description: Between County Road 51A and Shelton Lane (near Hayden) from Mile Point 108.5 to Mile Point 108.3. Road construction. Starting August 26, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until August 26, 2026 at about 7:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • August 26, 7:00AM - August 26, 7:00PM Comment: Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. in order to accommodate the commuter traffic on the US 40 corridor, Monday through Friday. Vehicles will be reduced to a single-lane, alternating traffic intermittently in either direction while the temporary detour is being built. The speed limit will be reduced to 30 mph through the work zone. The project is expected to last until early October. Several other projects are occurring this season on the US 40 corridor. For more information on these projects, please visit: www.cotrip.org

alerts.title: US 40 Milner Resurfacing-143242
alerts.description: Between Moonlight Way (1 mile west of the Steamboat Springs area) and County Road 29 (5 miles west of the Hayden area) from Mile Point 127.3 to Mile Point 100.4. Paving operations. Starting August 25, 2026 at 7:00PM MDT until August 26, 2026 at about 6:00AM MDT. Full schedule below: • August 25, 7:00PM - August 26, 6:00AM Comment: Work includes barrier placement for the slope stabilization and work on the bridge at MP 113 on the west end of the project limits. Nighttime hours will be 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Vehicles will be reduced to a single-lane, alternating traffic intermittently in either direction, throughout the duration of the project Lane closures, guided by flaggers, will have up to 10-minute delays. The speed limit will be reduced to 40 mph through the work zone. The project is expected to last until the middle of November.
